verdict.rationale: The Codex CLI agent is installed and runs locally from a public GitHub repo, so part of the product runs on the user's own machine. It still requires a ChatGPT sign-in or an OpenAI API key, and the cloud agent (Codex Web, isolated cloud environments) is OpenAI-hosted with no documented self-hosted deployment. missing for 10: a documented self-hosted deployment of the full product (including the cloud/web agent), the ability to run without OpenAI-hosted services or models, and self-hosting guides with independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product

citations.quote: Codex CLI is a coding agent from OpenAI that runs locally on your computer.
You can also use Codex with an API key, but this requires additional setup.
